inputs.text: Extreme minimal flat vector logo icon: an anime girl HEAD ONLY, no neck no shoulders, front-facing perfectly symmetric, built from five solid silhouette shapes: white bob haircut as one smooth shape, indigo underlayer as one solid band, two wide fluffy fox ears with pink inner, one white face shape. Large simple anime eyes with two white shines, tiny line mouth, nothing else on the face. Thick bold dark outlines, solid flat colors, plain white background with margin. Iconic, readable at 48 pixels, professional logo design, no text, no photo, no shadows
